agent_explanation: Fast body (vx~38.9, dt~0.0157 => ~0.61 units/step) crosses the right boundary between step 21 (x~18.95, inside) and step 22 (x~19.57, overshoot 0.389) with vx unchanged, i.e. no wall impulse applied. Likely cause: boundary collision detection/resolution misses the impact when the per-step displacement carries the centre fully past the wall face, so the body tunnels out instead of bouncing.
